name: Haggai
lede: The thirty-seventh book of the Bible, in full: the word of Jehovah by Haggai the prophet in the second year of Darius — is it a time for you to dwell in your ceiled houses, while this house lieth waste? consider your ways; be strong, and work, for I am with you; the latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former; and Zerubbabel as a signet — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Consider Your Ways
books.blurb: In the second year of Darius: this people say, it is not the time for Jehovah's house to be built — is it a time for you to dwell in your ceiled houses, while this house lieth waste? consider your ways: ye have sown much, and bring in little, wages into a bag with holes; go up to the mountain, and bring wood; Zerubbabel and Joshua and the remnant obeyed, and came and did work; be strong, all ye people of the land — I will shake all nations, and the latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former; holy flesh in the skirt of a garment; from this day will I bless you; and I will make thee as a signet.
